case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for your openness about wage developments at the foundry. We value your workforce's craftsmanship and the quality you deliver, and we take the rise in metal-industry wages seriously.

At the same time, we cannot accept the increase as proposed. We have prepared options that we believe reflect your cost situation fairly:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.80; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 45.43; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Each option offers a longer contract term, giving you more planning security for your foundry team. Option C keeps your current payment terms unchanged.

We look forward to your view.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your offer of a 24-month contract, which indeed provides valuable planning security for our foundry team. However, your proposed prices do not reflect our actual cost situation; please share the specific data you base your calculations on. Building on your Option C, we can offer a unit price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised options and your willingness to bridge the gap. While market indices provide a general overview, our actual production costs dictate the sustainable price required to maintain the high quality you expect from our foundry. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Building on your Option C, we are prepared to offer a further reduced price of €50.50 per unit. Our current offer provides a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

It is a pleasure to build on our long-standing relationship and work together to find a sustainable way forward for both of our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
